snippet.title: Cliffside Cafe - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4542400/Cliffside_Cafe/

Proud to officially announce that Cliffside Cafe now has a Steam page! I'll be working hard to get the game published on there, but for now you can play it in the browser at https://pufferfishgames.itch.io/cliffside. You can also join my community discord to keep up to date with my writing, game development, and community! 

https://discord.gg/SWNnhUrmQc
